findings.claim: SharkNinja 10-K 風險因子自陳技術變化加速（AI、機器人、感測器等），未能適應可能不利營運
findings.excerpt: The pace of technological change is increasing at an exponential rate. To remain competitive, we must invest in developing tools and processes to improve the speed at which we are able to develop competitive products

findings.claim: 瑞士零售商資料顯示中國品牌 Dreame、Roborock 已幾乎接管機器人吸塵器品類，Dyson 傳統吸塵器份額下滑
findings.source: Digitec/Galaxus, Chinese vacuum cleaner brands are blowing away their global competition
findings.excerpt: While Dyson still rules the roost, Chinese brands such as Dreame and Roborock have almost completely taken over the robot segment, leaving Western pioneers such as iRobot trailing behind.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅找到競品（非替代技術）證據；未找到取代核心產品之替代技術的直接來源。as_of 第二條為估計日期。
